leverage.exposure: The balance is negative and has been for several runs. It costs nothing until the instant the matchday locks, and the lock is more than two weeks away, so no buy this run is constrained by the deficit's mere existence — what constrains a buy is whether it can be unwound in time, and it comfortably can. The single Treu sale clears the whole deficit on its own, which is why the unwind is one leg rather than two. If the flip is taken, the deficit deepens by the bid and the position is unwound by selling the flipped player back at market value after tonight's update — Kickbase pays exactly market value, so that leg is certain. The absolute constraint is unchanged and outranks everything else on this page: the balance must be non-negative and the squad at least eleven before the lock, or the entire matchday scores zero.

binding_gap: There is no formation hole to fix this run, which is why nothing in the buy section leads. The binding constraint is not a position, it is the swap arithmetic: the squad is twelve and the XI is eleven, so any purchase has to be funded by a sale that removes a fielded player, and the net is simply the incoming average minus the outgoing one. Under a single funding leg the affordable band is tiny; under two legs the squad falls to eleven and Nakuzola enters the XI, which eats most of whatever the purchase adds. That is the whole reason the Brackelmann structure is worth so much less than his raw average suggests.

sell.reason: Treu remains the correct single unwind leg and the sale premise is unchanged — but this run adds the clock that was never specified, and it says do not execute today. Two independent reasons, both pointing the same way. He is rising: his flag is up, his market value gained ground over the last day and again in the trailing hour, and selling back to Kickbase pays exactly market value with no spread, so every further day held is free money on the sale leg at the measured rising-flag drift. And he is fielded: selling him drops the squad to eleven and forces Nakuzola into the XI from the moment of sale, so an early sale pays a points penalty every matchday it is early by. Execute on either trigger — his flag flipping to falling, or forty-eight hours before the lock, whichever comes first. This is a refinement of the sale, never a cancellation: the deficit must be unwound before the lock or the entire matchday scores zero. That branch costs nothing, keeps Deman's 101 in the eleven, and lands the balance non-negative with 11 players. DO NOT SELL DEMAN BEFORE 08.10 UNDER ANY CIRCUMSTANCES. Secondary timing point, worth ~290.000 on its own: Deman is mvt 1 with sdmvt +914.328 over seven days, so whenever his sale does happen it belongs AFTER a 20:00Z tick, never before one. News check this run: no current injury or selection item for Deman; the "Knoechelbruch" cluster on werder.de is 21.08.2025 and is LAST SEASON — do not let a future run read it as live.
